test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is CORRECT statement for Kishor category under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana?

options.text: Loan to small businessmen from 35 thousand up to 7.5 lakhs
Loan to small businessmen from 50 thousand up to 5 lakhs
Loan to small business from 75 thousand up to 15 lakhs
Loan to small businessmen from 25 thousand up to 5 lakhs

solution:
Correct answer is__** Loan to small businessmen from 50 thousand up to 5 lakhs.**__
